posts_checked.text:
我们费劲做一堆按钮，到底是给谁点的？为 Adobe，Photoshop 默哀 3 秒。

前段时间跟同事聊一个生成工具，聊了几轮，我突然发现：这工作台做出来，我们自己可能都懒得开。😂

我现在有活就先丢给 Grokbot。查新闻，让它找原始出处。写帖，丢段语音让它转录整理。做视频，让它调模型出画面、配旁白、加音乐。我只在关键节点看一眼。

看到下面评测，一句话从 233 辆车里找出 5 辆公交车，我第一反应也是：未来这些小模型的能力都会变成一个个 MCP，让大模型来调用。

可能有人说国内模型还比较弱，但花半年做一堆按钮，等上线，模型可能自己都会了。国内生成式 AI 用户已经超过 7 亿。等越来越多人习惯了说一句话就能把活干完，愿意回去点十几个按钮的人也就不见了。

为 Adobe，Photoshop 默哀，依然会有专业用户，是普通人只会用 Grok bot了。🫡

posts_checked.author: yyyole
posts_checked.text:
Especially freelancers, indie makers, creators, and anyone making a living from their skills and creativity.
Think about it.
You might have dozens of amazing projects, but they're scattered across folders, social media, and different platforms.

And when a potential client reaches out, you still have to explain everything from scratch:
What do you do? What have you created? How can we work together?
A well-built website can answer all of these questions for you.
Recently, I used @Teamily_AI 2.0's Website Builder to create a portfolio website for my AI video production business.
I brought in four of my actual projects, showcasing my work across AI commercials, creative ads, music videos, product launch films, and animation.
Everything now lives in one place: projects, production credits, services, and a clear way for potential clients to get in touch.
But what impressed me most was the Studio + Send to Agent workflow.

After generating the initial website, a friend gave me two specific suggestions:
“Make it clear what you handled on each project, and tell potential clients what information they should send when they first get in touch.”
With Send to Agent, that feedback could become specific revisions:
1.Add my actual video projects
2.Refine project descriptions and make my end-to-end production role clear
3.Improve the layout and website copy
4.Add a reusable project brief and a clearer path for business inquiries

What stood out was how the workflow connects people and AI: a friend can point out what a potential client might miss, and the Agent can turn that feedback into concrete changes on the page.

两者的设计思路其实非常接近，都是让 Agent 通过 JavaScript 一次完成多个工具调用，而不是像以前一样，每执行一个工具，都要把结果返回给模型，再决定下一步 https://t.co/ym5huV4utx https://t.co/eAxlBhBCjG

Claude 这次分享的最新文章，从底层的方式讲解了 Code Mode模式，它最大的改变就是：改变了 Agent 调用工具的方式

以前 Claude Code 搜索文件、读取内容、修改代码，每一步都需要把结果返回给模型，再决定下一步怎么做
